name: record_hold_confirmation
description: Record whether the hospital will keep the bed ready for this patient. Call this once, after they have answered and confirmed your read-back.

attempt_id.description: Internal attempt reference from the call context. Filled in automatically; never ask for it and never say it.

confirmed.description: yes if they will keep the bed ready, no if they can no longer take the patient.

contact_person.description: Name or role the ambulance team should ask for.

whatsapp_number.description: Optional WhatsApp number for the pre-arrival note, digits only. Leave empty if not given.

notes.description: Anything else they said that the doctor should know, in a few words. If confirmed is no, the reason.

to_number.description: The number you called. Filled in automatically; never ask for it.
